Model.Name: WPEndowModelReserving
Model.Notes: Reserving model layer - contains the present value of cash flows and discounting functionality

Formula.Name: AccidentalDeathBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AccidentalDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedAccidentalDeath_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Accidental_Death_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: AccidentalDeathUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AccidentalDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) - (AccidentalDeathBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Accidental_Death_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: AcquisitionAAWBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AcquisitionAAWBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedAquisitionAAW_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.AcquisitionAAW_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: AcquisitionAAWUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AcquisitionAAWBEL_WP(t + 1) - (AcquisitionAAWBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.AcquisitionAAW_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: AcquisitionExpenses_WP
Formula.Value: Return InitExpPerPolBEL_WP(t) + InitExpPercPremBEL_WP(t) + AcquisitionAAWBEL_WP(t)

Formula.Name: AmtInvestedBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AmtInvestedBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedAmtInvested_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) End If

Formula.Name: AnnuityBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AnnuityBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedAnnuity_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Annuity_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: BalDate
Formula.Value: 'Return GetBalDate(t - PeriodIF(), SMCoreModel.ValnDate, StepsPY) Return SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)

Formula.Name: CEPCBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CEPCBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedClaimExpPerClaim_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.CEPC_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: CEPCUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CEPCBEL_WP(t + 1) - (CEPCBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPerClaim_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: CUEntrepo_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.Funeral_cover(t)

Formula.Name: CU_Current_Service_WP
Formula.Value: 'If Date.FromOADate(ValDateStep(t)) = SMCoreModel.NextValnDate Then If Date.FromOADate(SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)) = SMCoreModel.NextValnDate Then Return CU_func_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: CU_Future_Service_WP
Formula.Value:
'If Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)) = SMCoreModel.NextValnDate Then ' Return FutureServiceCU(t) 'End If
If ValMonth(t) = 0 Then Return FutureServiceCU_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: CU_func_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else If t < ProjTerm() Return (Math.Max(Math.Max(SMCoreModel.Accidental_Death_cover(t), SMCoreModel.Natural_Death_cover(t)), Math.Max(SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_cover(t), SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_cover(t))) + SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.Funeral_cover(t)) * SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t - 1) Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: CashBackBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CashBackBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedCashbackBenefit_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Cashback_Benefits_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: CashBackUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CashBackBEL_WP(t + 1) - (CashBackBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Periodic_CashBack_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedClaimPercClaimAmt_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPercClaimAmt_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: ClaimPercClaimAmtUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL_WP(t + 1) - (ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPercClaimAmt_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: Claims_WP
Formula.Value: Return DeathBEL_WP(t) + AccidentalDeathBEL_WP(t) + NaturalDeathBEL_WP(t) + PermanentDisabilityBEL_WP(t) + TerminalIllnessBEL_WP(t) + TemporaryDisabilityBEL_WP(t) + RetrenchmentBEL_WP(t) + CriticalIllnessBEL_WP(t) + FuneralBEL_WP(t) + CashBackBEL_WP(t) + PaidUpBEL_WP(t) + AnnuityBEL_WP(t) + LumpsumDeathBEL_WP(t) + SurrenderBEL_WP(t) + WOPBEL_WP(t) + PartialSurrenderBEL_WP(t) + MaturityBEL_WP(t)

Formula.Name: ComissionClawbackBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ComissionClawbackBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedComissionClawback_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.ComissionClawback_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: ComissionClawbackUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ComissionClawbackBEL_WP(t + 1) - (ComissionClawbackBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Comission_Clawback_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: Comission_WP
Formula.Value: Return RenewalComissionBEL_WP(t) + ComissionClawbackBEL_WP(t) + InitialComissionBEL_WP(t) 'Clawback is negative in CF layer

Formula.Name: CommissionUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RenewalComissionBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RenewalComissionBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Renewal_Comission_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: CriticalIllnessBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CriticalIllnessBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedCriticalIllness_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: CriticalIllnessUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CriticalIllnessBEL_WP(t + 1) - (CriticalIllnessBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: DeathBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return DeathBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedDeath_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Death_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: FuneralBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return FuneralBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedFuneral_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Funeral_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: FuneralCoverUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return FuneralBEL_WP(t + 1) - (FuneralBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Funeral_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: FutureServiceCU_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return FutureServiceCU_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + CU_func_WP(t + 1) End If

Formula.Name: GrossBEL_WP
Formula.Value: Return PremiumsFinal_WP(t) + RenewalExpenses_WP(t) + Comission_WP(t) + AcquisitionExpenses_WP(t) + Claims_WP(t)

Formula.Name: GuaranteedOEInterestBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return GuaranteedOEInterestBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.GuaranteedOEInterest_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) End If

Formula.Name: Inf_input
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Inf_input()

Formula.Name: InitExpPerPolBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitExpPerPolBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedInitExpensePP_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.InitialExpensePP_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: InitExpPerPolUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitExpPerPolBEL_WP(t + 1) - (InitExpPerPolBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.InitialExpPP_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: InitExpPercPremBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitExpPercPremBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedInitExpPerPrem_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: InitExpPercPremUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitExpPercPremBEL_WP(t + 1) - (InitExpPercPremBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.InitialExpPercPremium_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: InitialComissionBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitialComissionBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedInitialComission_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Comission_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: LumpsumDeathBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return LumpsumDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedLumpsumDeath_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Lumpsum_Death_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: MaturityBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return MaturityBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedMaturity_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) End If

Formula.Name: NOM_input
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.NOM_input()

Formula.Name: NaturalDeathBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return NaturalDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedNaturalDeath_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Natural_Death_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: NaturalDeathUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return NaturalDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) - (NaturalDeathBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Natural_Death_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: OEValueBOMBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t <= ProjTerm() Return SMWPEndowModelCF.OEValueBOM_WP(t) Else If t < ProjTerm() Return OEValueBOMBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) End If '

Formula.Name: OEValueEOMBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t <= ProjTerm() Return SMWPEndowModelCF.OEValueEOM_WP(t) Else If t < ProjTerm() Return OEValueEOMBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) End If '

Formula.Name: PPEBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PPEBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedPPE_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.PPE_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PPEUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PPEBEL_WP(t + 1) - (PPEBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Per_pol_exp_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: PaidUpBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PaidUpBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedPaidUp_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) End If

Formula.Name: PartialSurrenderBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PartialSurrenderBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedPartialSurrender_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Surrender_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PercCUExpenseUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PercCUexpenseBEL_WP(t + 1) - (PercCUexpenseBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Perc_CU_exp_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: PercCUexpenseBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PercCUexpenseBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedPercCUExpense_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.PercCUExpense_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PercPremExpenseBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PercPremExpenseBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedPercPremExpense_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.PercPremiumExpense_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PercPremExpenseUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PercPremExpenseBEL_WP(t + 1) - (PercPremExpenseBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Perc_premium_exp_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: PeriodIF
Formula.Value: 'Return DateSpan.TermInMonths(SMCoreModel.CoverStartDate, SMCoreModel.ValuationDate) Return SMCoreModel.PeriodIF()

Formula.Name: PermanentDisabilityBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PermanentDisabilityBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedPermanentDisability_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PermenentDisabilityUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PermanentDisabilityBEL_WP(t + 1) - (PermanentDisabilityBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: PremInvestedBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PremInvestedBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.AllocatedPrem_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) End If

Formula.Name: PremiumsBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PremiumsBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedPremiums_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Premiums_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PremiumsFinal_WP
Formula.Value: Return PremiumsBEL_WP(t)

Formula.Name: PremiumsUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: 'Return NextValPVPremiums(t) - (PVPremiums(t) + PVPremiumRelease(t)) If t < ProjTerm() - 1 Return PremiumsBEL_WP(t + 1) - (PremiumsBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.PremiumCF(t)) End If

Formula.Name: ProjTerm
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.ProjTerm

Formula.Name: RIAccidentalDeathBEL_WP
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIAccidentalDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.AccidentalDeathRIRecoveries_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIAccidentalDeathUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIAccidentalDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RIAccidentalDeathBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.AccidentalDeathRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RICU_WP
Formula.Value: Return (Math.Max(Math.Max(SMCoreModel.AccidentalDeathRICover(t), SMCoreModel.NaturalDeathRICover(t)), Math.Max(SMCoreModel.TerminalIllnessRICover(t), SMCoreModel.TemporaryDisabilityRICover(t))) + SMCoreModel.DeathRICover(t) + SMCoreModel.PermanentDisabilityRICover(t) + SMCoreModel.RetrenchmentRICover(t) + SMCoreModel.CriticalIllnessRICover(t) + SMCoreModel.FuneralRICover(t)) * SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: RICriticalIllnessBEL_WP
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RICriticalIllnessBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.CriticalIllessRIRecoveries_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RICriticalIllnessUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RICriticalIllnessBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RICriticalIllnessBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.CriticalIllnessRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RIDeathBEL_WP
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.DeathRIRecoveries_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIDeathUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RIDeathBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.DeathRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RIFuneralBEL_WP
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIFuneralBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.FuneralRIRecoveries_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIFuneralUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIFuneralBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RIFuneralBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.FuneralRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RIFutureServiceCU_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIFutureServiceCU_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t)) ^ (-1) + RICU_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: RINaturalDeathBEL_WP
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RINaturalDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.NaturalDeathRIRecoveries_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RINaturalDeathUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RINaturalDeathBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RINaturalDeathBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.NaturalDeathRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RIPermanentDisabilityBEL_WP
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIPermanentDisabilityBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.PermanentDisRIRecoveries_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIPermanentDisabilityUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIPermanentDisabilityBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RIPermanentDisabilityBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.PermanentDisabilityRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RIRetrenchmentBEL_WP
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIRetrenchmentBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.RetrenchmentRIRecoveries_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIRetrenchmentUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIRetrenchmentBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RIRetrenchmentBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.RetrenchmentRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RITemporaryDisabilityBEL_WP
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RITemporaryDisabilityBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.TemporaryDisabilityRIRecoveries_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RITemporaryDisabilityUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RITemporaryDisabilityBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RITemporaryDisabilityBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.TemporaryDisabilityRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RITerminalIllnessBEL_WP
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RITerminalIllnessBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.TerminalIllnessRIRecoveries_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RITerminalIllnessUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RITerminalIllnessBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RITerminalIllnessBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.TerminalIllnessRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RenewalComissionBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RenewalComissionBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedRenewalComission_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Comission_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: RenewalExpenses_WP
Formula.Value: Return PPEBEL_WP(t) + PercPremExpenseBEL_WP(t) + PercCUexpenseBEL_WP(t) + CEPCBEL_WP(t) + ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL_WP(t)

Formula.Name: RetrenchmentBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RetrenchmentBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedRetrenchment_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: RetrenchmentUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RetrenchmentBEL_WP(t + 1) - (RetrenchmentBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: SurrenderBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return SurrenderBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedSurrender_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Surrender_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: SurrenderUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return SurrenderBEL_WP(t + 1) - (SurrenderBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Surrender_cover_factor(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: TemporaryDisabilityBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return TemporaryDisabilityBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedTemporaryDisability_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: TemporaryDisabilityUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return TemporaryDisabilityBEL_WP(t + 1) - (TemporaryDisabilityBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: TerminalIllnessBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return TerminalIllnessBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedTerminalIllness_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: TerminalIllnessUnwind_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return TerminalIllnessBEL_WP(t + 1) - (TerminalIllnessBEL_WP(t) + SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: ValMonth
Formula.Value: Return t - PeriodIF()

Formula.Name: WOPBEL_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return WOPBEL_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMWPEndowModelCF.ExpectedWOP_WP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.WOP_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: fnRiskDiscountRate
Formula.Value: If t <= ProjTerm() If SMCoreModel.NonUnit_discount_perc_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Then Return (1 + SMCoreModel.NonUnit_discount_perc + SMCoreModel.Investment_expense_perc + SMCoreModel.Int_margin_ind * SMCoreModel.Int_margin_val) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 Else Return (1 + Economic_curves.Value(Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)), SMCoreModel.NOM_input()) + SMCoreModel.Investment_expense_perc + SMCoreModel.Int_margin_ind * SMCoreModel.Int_margin_val) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 End If End If
